displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 987MA Series A modulating furnace (Form 987MA-01T). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 42 is 4 short and 2 long
meaning: Inducer motor fault on a Bryant 987MA modulating furnace. The inducer has not started within 20 seconds after a call for heat, the inducer RPM is outside its valid range, or the RPM signal was lost for 5 seconds during operation.
causes: Inducer did not start within 20 seconds of a call for heat
Inducer RPM outside its valid range, or the RPM signal lost for 5 seconds
Vent sizing is wrong, or the vent is restricted
diySteps: Look at the outdoor intake and exhaust terminations for a blockage. Leave the pipes connected
Technician: check vent sizing, a restricted vent, and the inducer motor. This code is not blower fault 41
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the terminations are clear and 42 remains. Inducer replacement is not a homeowner job.
